'''Keren''' was an important trading [[City/Legends|city]] located on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
[[File:Keren_map.png|thumb|250px|Map of Keren]]
Keren was the most important trading city on Naboo. The city was a bustling hive of mercantile activity. Planetary as well as interstellar traders could be found here, amid a wide assortment of goods and products.<ref name="SWG:K">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Starting Location: "Keren "</ref> Keren was home to one of the planet's [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]], named [[Kwilaan Starport/Legends|Kwilaan Starport]], which was located in its own section in the western part of the city.<ref name="SoN" /> Keren was also a major hub for the criminal element in the sector. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were common in the city.<ref name="SWG:K" />

Keren was also renowned as a stunning example of architecture and nature complimenting each other. The streets and buildings were organized in accordance with the local channels and waterfalls.<ref name="SWG:K" /> [[Lake Varum]] lay on the edge of the city.<ref name="SoN" /> There was also a canal that curved its way through the middle of Keren, ending at the [[Keren Grand Arch]] that overlooked the cityscape.<ref name="SWG" />

The city was also the site of the [[Keren Street Race]].<ref name="SWG:KSR" />

==History==
{{Quote|Naboo – city of Keren: As the Emperor's home world, Naboo is the beating heart of the Empire. To establish a control point on this planet would not only supply access to crucial intelligence, but would also be a devastating blow to Imperial morale and the Emperor himself. With its high level of commerce and financial influence throughout the Naboo system, Keren is the perfect target for this operation.|[[Ysanne Isard]], [[Imperial Naval Communiqué 31756]]|<ref name="GCWFUS">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68602&month=012010|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies™ Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege (Game Update 15)}}</ref>}}
Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Keren was the largest city on Naboo as well as the center of the planet's small underworld, notably [[Shep Contopault]]'s and [[Hesh Verbon]]'s operations. Due to several disappearances in the city, it has also been rumored that there was [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trafficking in and around the Kwilaan Starport.<ref name="SoN" />

During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], several [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo guards]] were stationed in Keren, such as [[Hexler Pend]]. They hid in an armory in the city, but were found and forced to surrender as a [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] knocked the armory's [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] walls down.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] led by slavemaster [[Trussk]] was [[Trussk's house|based]] in Keren.<ref name="SWG:Gc" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of spacers attacked Trussk's fortress on Naboo, killing most slavers during the raid. These adventurers were investigating the disappearance of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Cal Handro]] and suspected the Blackscale Clan to have captured him.<ref name="SWG:Gc" />

The same year, a [[Maulers|Mauler]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] known as the [[Mauler Usurper]] attempted to attack the city of Keren. However, his plan was [[Royal Security Forces police raid on Mauler base|foiled]] by the [[Royal Security Police Force]] and the warlord was killed in the nearby [[Mauler Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:TPW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - Police Work|Naboo}}</ref>

Keren later became a hotspot of [[Invasion of Keren|skirmishes]] between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] intensified.<ref name="SWG:GU15">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Game Update 15: Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege</ref> One of the Rebel Alliance's leaders, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], sent a transmission to all [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] to tell them to rally ships and available ground forces to three cities in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]: Keren, [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. Organa thought that, with its high level of commerce and financial influence throughout the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], Keren was a critical strategic point. Furthermore, as Naboo was [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], she hoped the Alliance would get access to crucial intelligence.<ref name="GCWFUS" />

==Inhabitants==
The following individuals were residents or visitors of the city in the time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]: [[Demitri Firewatcher]], [[Bardo Klinj]], [[Brennis Doore]], [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], [[Kritus Morven]], [[Lergo Brazee]], [[Vana Sage]],<ref name="SWG" /> [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] and [[Ogden (smuggler)|Ogden]].<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Keren was first mentioned in the short story "[[The Starfighter Trap]]" by [[Steve Miller]]. The story was published in three parts online, with the first part appearing on [[StarWars.com]] on [[October 27]], [[2000]]. The city is referenced by [[Rhys Dallows]] in a line of dialogue where he mentions encountering a [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]] [[Purchasing Agent]] in Keren.
<ref name="StarWarsStarfighterTrap">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/f20001027|text=The Starfighter Trap}}</ref> When the story was republished in ''[[Star Wars Gamer 1]]''<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref> in [[November]] [[2000]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Gamer Special Edition]]''</ref> the line featuring Keren instead referred to the city of [[Oxon City|Oxon]].<ref name="Gamer" />
